question: A computer program that converts an entire program into machine language is called a/an________.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Compiler**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A compiler **is a computer programme that translates computer code written in one** programming language (the source language)** into another** language (the target language).**
 
• For programmes that convert source code from a high-level programming language to a lower-level language** (e.g., assembly language, object code, or computer code),** the term 'compiler' is primarily used to construct an executable programme.
 
• **Compilers** are not the only language processors that are used to **translate source programmes.**
 
• An interpreter is a **computer programme** that converts the operations indicated and then executes them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A simulation **is an approximate imitation of a** process or system's** operation which reflects its operation over time.
 
• An** interpreter** is a computer programme that directly executes instructions written in a programming or scripting language, without having to compile them in advance into a **computer language programme.**
